entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This application for bail has been filed by the applicants under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 in connection with FIR No.180/2023, registered at Police Station Gida, District Balotra for the offences under sections 447, 343, 347, 365, 366, 376(2)(N), 376-D & 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. After arguing for some time, Mr. Bishnoi, learned counsel for the applicant does not press the bail application qua accused No.2 Jaswant Singh and seeks permission to withdraw the same.
3. Permission granted.
4. The bail application qua applicant No.2 Jaswant Singh is dismissed as withdrawn.

5. So far as bail application qua applicant No.1 Sawai Singh is concerned, Mr. Bishnoi argued that that prosecutrix has vindictively levelled allegation of rape upon the applicant in her statement recorded under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

entities.text: Sawai Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:2485)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel highlighted that neither in the FIR nor in the statement recorded under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the prosecutrix has levelled any allegation of sexual assault upon the applicant Sawai Singh and therefore, her version given under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is not trustworthy.

7. Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application by contending that in her statement under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the prosecutrix has levelled clear allegation of sexual assault upon the applicant Sawai Singh as well.

8. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.
9.
It is to be noted that in the FIR, the prosecutrix has alleged sexual assault only by Jaswant Singh (applicant No.2).

In her statement under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 she has not only confined her allegations qua Jaswant Singh, but has specifically mentioned that other boys who were with Jaswant Singh had not done any forceful/wrongful act.
10.

Such being the position, in the opinion of this Court, prosecutrix' statement under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 cannot be read divorced of her version given in [2024:RJ-JD:2485] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-16303/2023] the statement under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and the FIR.

11. This Court, therefore, deems it just and proper to grant bail to the accused-applicant No.1 Sawai Singh under section 439 Cr.P.C.
12.
Consequently, the bail application filed under section 439 Cr.P.C. qua applicant Sawai Singh is allowed.

The applicant Sawai Singh S/o Bhikh Singh, arrested in connection with FIR No.180/2023,
registered at Police Station Gida, District Balotra shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
13. Applicant shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
14. Needless to mention that the above observations made by this Court are on the basis of material so far produced before the Court.

These are only prima-facie observations and the same shall however, not come in the way of the trial Court to take independent view of the matter, based on ocular and oral evidence, while finally deciding the case.

(DINESH MEHTA),J 898-Ramesh/-
